fixes.explanation: A vineyard, baker! Noah, a man of the soil, plants one, and then he drinks some of its wine (Genesis 9:20-21). I know a thing or two about a batch going sideways. I once left a tray in the oven for one more minute. ONE minute. The text doesn't hide what happened next, and neither will I.

Olive grove! I get it, friend, it sounds so farmer-ish, so very Bible. But the verse says Noah, a man of the soil, planted a vineyard (Genesis 9:20). Verse 21 then mentions its wine, so no olives in this one. Don't worry, I've mixed up a topping before too, and the cookies forgave me.
